name: Akehara Madoka
source:
A girl who has been hospitalized for a long time due to having an incurable disease. Madoka had rarely been outside ever since she was born. Her favorite thing is the teddy bear she calls "Luke" that was given to her by her father before going to assignment overseas. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.gamer.ne.jp/news/201211150003/]4Gamer[/url].]
